name: browser-guard-fixtures
_comment: Not a workspace (the root globs are packages/* and apps/*). It exists for its `imports` map alone: `#fake-external-dep` is a BARE specifier, so the entry below reaches its offending module the way codex's dist reached @ardrive/turbo-sdk — through a dependency the guard must WALK INTO. Resolve it through node's subpath-imports instead of a real node_modules fixture so nothing has to be installed (and nothing can be .gitignored away) for the gate to bite.
